global_config_schema.title: S3 storage connection
global_config_schema.description: Authenticated S3 objects. Immutable versions by default; checked ETag reads require an explicit opt-in.
global_config_schema.json_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"source_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$"},"source_name":{"type":"string","maxLength":256},"bucket":{"type":"string","maxLength":63,"default":""},"prefix":{"type":"string","maxLength":1024,"default":""},"region":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":64},"endpoint":{"type":"string","maxLength":2048},"access_key":{"type":"string","maxLength":1024},"secret_key":{"type":"string","maxLength":4096},"session_token":{"type":"string","maxLength":8192},"revision_mode":{"type":"string","enum":["versioned","checked-etag"],"default":"versioned","description":"Versioned requires immutable VersionIds. fields.label: Name (optional)
fields.description: How this source is shown in Bloem. Leave empty to use the bucket name.

fields.label: Bucket (optional)
fields.description: Leave empty to cover every bucket these keys can see; each bucket is a folder.

fields.label: Folder (optional)
fields.description: Leave empty to use the whole bucket (recommended). You choose folders for each library later. Needs a bucket.

fields.label: Address
fields.description: The https:// address your storage provider gave you.

fields.label: How Bloem checks files
fields.description: Read exact file versions only needs versioning turned on for the bucket; files without a version are refused. Check each file before and after reading works with every bucket and still uses versions when there are any, but cannot prove the bytes are unchanged if the service reuses a fingerprint.

options.label: Read exact file versions only (needs versioning)
Check each file before and after reading (any bucket)
